What Types of Skin Treatments Are Offered at Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic in Noida?

Reviva May 8, 2025

When it comes to maintaining healthy, radiant skin and addressing both medical and cosmetic concerns, choosing the right clinic is vital. For residents of Noida and nearby areas, Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic has earned a reputation as the best skin and surgery clinic in Noida. Spearheaded by the highly skilled and compassionate Dr. Aarushi Tyagi, the clinic offers a wide range of advanced skin treatments designed to enhance appearance, restore skin health, and boost self-confidence.

If u want to know about us, follow us on Instagram and Facebook.

From laser hair reduction to scar removal and anti-aging therapies, Reviva combines medical expertise with state-of-the-art technology to deliver safe, effective, and personalized care. Let’s explore the wide range of skin treatments offered at the clinic, along with their benefits, effectiveness, and why Reviva is your go-to destination for comprehensive dermatological care.

1. Laser Hair Reduction

Unwanted hair can be a constant hassle. At Reviva, laser hair reduction is performed using cutting-edge lasers that are safe for all skin types. It offers long-lasting results, significantly reducing the need for waxing or shaving.

Benefits:

  • Pain-free and quick sessions
  • Precision targeting of hair follicles
  • Long-term hair reduction
  • Ideal for the face, arms, legs, bikini area, and underarms

2. Acne Treatment

Acne isn’t just a teenage issue—it can persist or even begin in adulthood. Reviva provides tailored acne treatment plans that include topical applications, chemical peels, and medical-grade facials.

Effectiveness:

  • These treatments help reduce inflammation, clear blocked pores, and prevent future breakouts while maintaining skin hydration and texture.

3. Acne Scar Management

For many, acne leaves behind long-lasting scars. The clinic uses advanced techniques such as microneedling, laser therapy, and chemical resurfacing to treat various types of acne scars.

Benefits:

  • Improves skin texture and tone
  • Reduces the visibility of scars
  • Promotes natural collagen production

4. Pigmentation Treatment

Hyperpigmentation and melasma can affect confidence. At Reviva, treatments like chemical peels, laser toning, and topical medications are used to reduce pigmentation.

Result:

  • A more even skin tone and visibly brighter complexion after a few sessions.

If u want to know about us, follow us on Instagram and Facebook.

5. Anti-Ageing Solutions

Age gracefully with non-surgical anti-ageing treatments at Reviva. Options include Butox, dermal fillers, thread lifts, and skin tightening procedures.

Why Choose It:

  • Reduces fine lines and wrinkles
  • Restores volume loss
  • Boosts collagen
  • Gives skin a youthful appearance

6. Tattoo Removal

Whether it’s for professional reasons or personal change, tattoo removal at Reviva is done using FDA-approved Q-switched laser technology.

Advantages:

  • Targets tattoo pigment without damaging skin
  • Minimal discomfort
  • Fewer sessions with visible results

7. Nail Treatments

The clinic addresses fungal infections, brittle nails, and other nail concerns with advanced dermatotrichology.

Treatment Goals:

  • Improve nail strength and health
  • Treat underlying fungal or bacterial infections
  • Restore cosmetic appearance

8. Clinical Dermatosurgery

Under the guidance of Dr. Aarushi Tyagi, Reviva offers expert clinic-based dermatosurgical procedures for skin tags, warts, moles, and cysts.

Highlights:

  • Performed under local anesthesia
  • Quick recovery
  • Minimal scarring

9. Dermatosurgery

More comprehensive than clinical dermatosurgery, this includes minor skin surgeries such as biopsies, cyst removals, and scar revisions.

Trust Factor:

  • All surgeries are performed in sterile environments using best-in-class instruments, ensuring patient safety and success.

10. Hair Transplant

Hair loss can deeply affect self-esteem. Reviva offers hair transplant procedures using the latest FUE (Follicular Unit Extraction) method.

Why Patients Prefer It:

  • Natural-looking results
  • No visible scarring
  • Boosts hair density and confidence
  • Minimal downtime

11. Double Chin Treatment

A double chin is a common aesthetic concern. At Reviva, non-surgical options like fat melting injections and RF contouring are available.

Results:

  • Tighter jawline
  • Fat reduction under the chin
  • No surgery required

12. Vaginal Tightening

Reviva offers vaginal rejuvenation using laser technology for tightening and improving elasticity.

Benefits:

  • Improves intimate health
  • Enhances comfort
  • Painless and non-invasive

13. Open Pores Treatment

Open pores make the skin look rough and aged. Reviva treats this using laser resurfacing, derma rollers, and chemical peels.

Outcome:

  • Reduced pore size
  • Smoother and firmer skin
  • Enhanced skin glow

Why Choose Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic?

Being recognized as the best skin and surgery clinic in Noida, Reviva stands out for several reasons:

  • Expertise of Dr. Aarushi Tyagi: A trusted skin specialist known for her patient-centric approach and precision treatments.
  • Modern Infrastructure: Clean, well-equipped clinic using FDA-approved technologies.
  • Customized Care: Each treatment is tailored to the unique needs of the patient after thorough consultation.
  • Safety First: Strict hygiene, transparency, and ethical practices.
  • Affordable Packages: Cost-effective treatments with quality assurance.

Conclusion

If you’re looking for reliable, result-oriented, and patient-friendly skincare solutions, Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic in Noida is your destination. Whether it’s acne, unwanted hair, aging signs, or surgical dermatology, the clinic provides the highest standard of care under the experienced hands of Dr. Aarushi Tyagi.

From consultation to treatment and aftercare, every step at Reviva is designed to ensure optimal results and complete satisfaction. Experience the transformation of your skin and confidence at the best skin and surgery clinic in Noida.
